title: Manga 'Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyou to Shitara, Betsu no Tatakai ga Hajimatta.' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Kengo Matsumoto 's Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyou to Shitara, Betsu no Tatakai ga Hajimatta. ( When Trying to Get Back at the Hometown Bullies, Another Battle Began ) manga on Friday, revealing the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Rock Paper Landmine Novel Gets Stage Play in January
content: Kadokawa announced on Friday that Yugo Aosaki 's Jirai Glico ( Glico with Landmines ) novel is getting a stage play adaptation that will run in Tokyo on January 22-24. Masahiko Kawahara is directing the play and Takayuki Kayano is writing the scripts.
author: ANN

title: 'Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The official website of the Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon ( A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage ) television anime unveiled additional cast, staff, the theme songs, a key visual (pictured), and first promotional video on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 2nd New Armored Trooper Votoms Anime Film to Open in 2027
content: The staff for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise, revealed on Friday the second film will open in 2027.

title: 'I am the only one who is not attacked in the world filled with zombies' Anime Reveals More Cast, January 1 TV Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Rokuro Uraji 's I am the only one who is not attacked in the world filled with zombies . ( Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore Dake ga Osowarenai ) novel series announced more cast members and the anime's January 1 premiere on the AT-X channel on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 3 Things We Need to See in Solo Leveling’s New Movie
content: After making fans wait for more than a year, A-1 Pictures confirmed a Solo Leveling film, which will follow the events after the second season. The film was announced during this year’s Anime Expo when fans from all over the world were keeping up with updates on upcoming projects.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Fukakōryoku no I Love You Film Casts M!LK Idol Shunta Sono
content: The official website for the live-action film of Mizuki Hoshino 's Fukakōryoku no I Love You (I Love You by Force Majeure) manga revealed on Friday that the film has cast M!LK idol group member Shunta Sono as Saku's intuitive childhood friend Rentarō Akizuki.
author: ANN
